prompt: Write a single, self-contained prompt for a text-to-image model that has never heard of Chinese memes, so that it draws a cat version of the "大笑奶龙" (Laughing Nailong / 奶蛙) meme. Output only the prompt.
answer: A funny, meme-style 3D glossy CGI render of a chubby, round, stylized cartoon cat bursting into hysterical, uncontrollable laughter. The cat has a plump, pear-shaped, squishy body with very short stubby legs, soft bright yellow-orange fur, small triangular cat ears, and cute whiskers, sitting down with its round belly sticking out. Its head is thrown slightly back with an exaggeratedly massive, wide-open mouth taking up half its face, exposing a pink tongue, gums, and tiny stubby teeth in an obnoxious, booming belly laugh. Its eyes are tightly squeezed shut into happy downward crescents with single comical joy-tears glistening at the corners, and one short paw is slapping its own round belly in amusement. Smooth plasticine-like 3D animation texture similar to modern toddler cartoons, bright playful studio lighting, vibrant colors, centered composition on a plain soft pastel background, expressive slapstick comedy vibe.
